IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy copper
hair falls over one shoulder, with a long multicolor
knit scarf draped across her body. She wears a
strapless fitted denim bustier with frayed edges and
button front, paired with a dark washed denim maxi
skirt with a frayed hem. A fluffy leopard-print
faux-fur bag and brown pointed suede mules
complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, gray studio backdrop with even light.
Palette of indigo denim, warm brown, and
multicolor knit. Warm and textured, in the style of
an autumn editorial.
